hypothesis: Exp6 (tone lane, parent exp_0005): add a REGISTER-TRANSLATION stage. Answer composition splits into an internal grounded-draft pass (clinical content locked: numbers/meds/timeframes/percentages verbatim) followed by a translation pass that rewrites the pair into a real text-message exchange — person asking about their own body/life (first/second person, no academic or bare-definitional framing), counselor texting back in second person ('you'/'your'). Trace evidence: third-person clinical/definitional questions score tone 0.2-0.5 while personal-framed ones hit 0.8, but ALL pairs cap at 0.8 because answers stay third-person textbook prose. exp_0001 decoupled only the question register; this decouples the answer register too (the longer, heavier-weighted half). Holds spec/ground/clin via explicit content-lock.
